comment: The pager's client: the VMM process that maps a memory region (vmmemory.Mapping), as connection_linux.go speaks to it. The test client is mapping and batchedMapping in vmmemory/memory_test.go; the campaigns attach with batchedMapping on odd seeds. See scripts/check-faults.py.

faults.purpose: a command whose answer never came, so the pager cannot tell whether the client applied it: the region is terminal from here; the file is given before the answer is lost
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: a command whose answer never came, so the pager cannot tell whether the client applied it: the region is terminal from here; the file is not dropped
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: the client out of VMAs refuses before it touches anything; the fault is served again once a revocation lands
a command whose answer never came, so the pager cannot tell whether the client applied it: the region is terminal from here; the pages are mapped before the answer is lost
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: a command whose answer never came, so the pager cannot tell whether the client applied it: the region is terminal from here; the zeros are mapped
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: a revocation the client out of VMAs refuses, which no fault can serve again: terminal for the region
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: a command whose answer never came, so the pager cannot tell whether the client applied it: the region is terminal from here; the page stays mapped
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: a command whose answer never came, so the pager cannot tell whether the client applied it: the region is terminal from here; the access is not completed
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: a command whose answer never came, so the pager cannot tell whether the client applied it: the region is terminal from here; the pages stay writable
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: a batch the client out of VMAs refuses before any of its commands lands
a command whose answer never came, so the pager cannot tell whether the client applied it: the region is terminal from here; every run of the batch is mapped
faults.deferred: TASK-111: a seed whose region fails of it does not replay yet

faults.purpose: as Revoke's refusal, for a batch
